_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the rescued children in the village (hub_children). S6 (docs/gameplay/23 §8): "How are things?" changes with the story (news_*: the latest chapter done).

text.zh_TW: 村子的新學堂裡，米菈在教孩子們寫自己的名字。她舉起一張紙：「看！他們每一個人都會寫了！以後再也沒有人能把名字從名冊上撕掉！」
text.en: In the village's new schoolroom, Mira is teaching the children to write their own names. She holds up a sheet of paper. "Look! Every one of them can write it now! Nobody will ever tear a name out of a ledger again!"

text.zh_TW: 最小的孩子跑過來：「哥哥！我會寫你的名字了！」她舉起一張紙，上面歪歪扭扭地寫著「里歐」。
text.en: The smallest child runs up. "Big brother! I can write your name now!" She holds up a sheet of paper. On it, in wobbly letters: "Leo".
